Pizza Is The Heart Of Our Restaurant. We Use Only Selected Italian Ingredients, From Flour To Tomato, From Cheeses To Cold Cuts, With No Compromise On Quality. Our Traditional High-Hydration Italian Pizza Is Made With A 90% Water Dough, Slowly Matured For At Least 36 Hours. The Result Is A Crispy, Light, Highly Digestible Pizza, Full Of Flavor
